items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Jack Kapp with the Decca, changed my name to Mary Lou Williams... When we went to Chicago to record for Jack Kapp

ctx.x: I just mixed them up. Often when someone was interviewing me I said Mary Lou Winn and I'd say Mary Lou Burley. One time I said Mary Louise Winn Burley, until Jack Kapp with the Decca, changed my name to Mary Lou Williams. Well, I had married John Williams, so he changed my name to Mary Lou Williams.
Up until that point had you ever called yourself professionally Mary Lou Williams?
